sensitivity_analysis.method: One-at-a-time parameter perturbation. HR_PER_ELN_BELOW_21 uses SEER 95% CI [0.949, 0.980] per 5 ELN; HR_PER_ELN_ABOVE_21 uses medically sensible range [0.95, 1.00] (diminishing returns to complete plateau); other parameters use ±20%.

consistency_summary.overall_assessment: Model 1 vs Model 5: 3/3 approaches have M1 median within M5 P5-P95 range; range overlap in 3/3. Model 3 vs Model 6 max |HR diff| = 0.1174.

summary.interpretation: Sensitivity: median RRR swing = 1.50 pp (max = 30.00 pp, driven by 'HR_PER_ELN_ABOVE_21'); max P(ELN>=21) swing = 0.40 pp. Bootstrap 95% CI width for Mattox P(ELN>=21) = 3.30 pp. Cross-validation: 3/3 M1 medians fall within M5 P5-P95. Overall robustness: STRONG (median-swing based; max-swing parameter reported as key uncertainty).
